items.name: risks
risks: Candidate source label is now 'manifest-sha256:' + lowercase SHA256 of inputs/candidate-copy-after.json. The label differs from historical labels. argv and expected options use the same variable, so validation stays consistent.

Candidate source is checked from the isolated copy (candidate_source), not the repository working tree. This binds to the built executable. Repository drift after P1 is not checked. dist_manifest is not checked by either runner; the original runners did not check dist either.

Both runners assert state.status prefix P2_GENERATION_ORACLE_PROBES_ENDED. If the main session rewrites state.status after P3/P4/P5, later runners stop. Keep the status until capacity ends, or rebind.
The P2 status prefix is also written when stage probes end FAIL_DIAGNOSTIC_RETAINED. Runners do not read stage_probes. This matches the contract separation of diagnostics and formal gates.
state.json is read without a pinned hash. execution-contract.json records state_status but not the state.json SHA256 or the P2 oracle summary hash.

Capacity reads corpus-a250-verification.json with utf-8-sig. The file contains UTF-8 non-ASCII SQL text. Under the cp936 locale default (observed), the original read_text() raises UnicodeDecodeError ('gbk' codec, byte 0xAE at position 3177). The new decoding keeps the SQL text identical to the file bytes; SQL semantics unchanged.

Capacity A250 30d expected rows still come from the historical A250 oracle file. A50 rows and 1d rows come only from runtime SQL. P2 oracle outputs under oracle/run-20261002 are not cross-checked by the runner.
Duplicate 'import sys' in run-capacity.py is harmless.

required_fixes.R1: run-capacity.py: call competing_load() before computing receipt started_utc (for example load = competing_load(); then build the receipt with started_utc and competing_load_at_start=load), so the generatedUtc lower bound is taken immediately before Popen as in the original.
required_fixes.R2: run-formal-replay.py: move INITIAL_LOAD = competing_load() and its assert before 'assert not OUT.exists() and not DATA.exists()' and the mkdir calls.
required_fixes.R3: Both runners: extend competing_load() to match the batch executable basenames (baseline-monitor-bench.exe, candidate-monitor-bench.exe, candidate-monitor-db.exe, candidate-library-tests.exe) or the STATE executable_identities paths; add monitor-db.exe to capacity; match python cmdlines of run-formal-replay.py, run-capacity.py, builder.py, generator.py and read-corpus-oracle.py, excluding os.getpid().

recommended: Record state.json SHA256 and the P2 oracle summary.json SHA256 in each execution-contract.json.
Keep state.status prefix P2_GENERATION_ORACLE_PROBES_ENDED until capacity ends, or rebind the status assert.
After fixes, regenerate both .patch files and record new runner SHA256 values before re-review.
